info.title: RRB ALP Mock Test Platform API
info.description: Backend API for the RRB ALP preparation platform. Provides question bank, mock test generation, exam attempts, PDF processing, and AI-powered question validation.

get.description: Returns the Google OAuth authorization URL. The frontend should redirect the user's browser to this URL.
Google redirects here after the user grants consent. Exchanges the authorization code for a JWT access token.

post.description: Stateless JWT logout — the backend does not maintain a session. The frontend must discard the stored access token.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile information.
Returns all exam subjects in display order. No authentication required — used to populate filters and navigation.

schema.title: Response List Subjects Api Subjects Get

get.description: Returns a single subject by its UUID.
Returns topics, optionally filtered by subject. Pass ?subject_id=<uuid> to get topics for a specific subject only.

schema.title: Response List Topics Api Topics Get

get.description: Returns a single topic by its UUID.
Returns a paginated, filterable list of questions from the question bank. Response items use ExamQuestionResponse — correct_answer and explanation are NEVER included.

post.description: Manually add a question to the bank. AI_GENERATED questions must have source_year=null. All manually created questions start with verification_status=UNVERIFIED.

get.description: Returns question text and options. correct_answer and explanation are NEVER included in this response. Backend grading accesses correct_answer directly from the database.

patch.description: Update any subset of question fields. All fields are optional.

schema.title: Response Delete Question Api Questions  Question Id  Delete

post.description: Synchronously validates a single question. Updates text, options, answer, and status.

post.summary: Queue a batch of questions for validation
post.description: Asynchronously validates a batch of questions using Celery (USE_CELERY=true only).

schema.title: Response Validate Questions Batch Api Questions Validate Batch Post

post.summary: Generate new mock test questions via AI
post.description: Generates questions and returns them. Does not save them to the database.

schema.title: Response Generate Questions Api Questions Generate Post

post.description: Generates a new randomised mock test from the question bank. Questions are randomly selected from VERIFIED questions matching the filters. Returns a 400 if the question bank doesn't have enough matching questions.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's mock tests, newest first.

get.summary: Get mock test with question list
get.description: Returns full mock test details including the ordered list of question_ids. The frontend uses this to start the exam — question_ids are passed to the attempt engine which fetches questions individually.

post.description: Creates an attempt record in NOT_STARTED state. Call POST /attempts/{id}/start to begin the timer.
Transitions the attempt from NOT_STARTED to IN_PROGRESS. Sets started_at and expires_at on the server. Safe to call again if already started (idempotent).

get.description: Returns the current attempt status. seconds_remaining is computed by the server from expires_at. If the timer has expired, the attempt is auto-submitted and status=EXPIRED is returned.

post.description: Upserts one or more answers in a single call. Safe to call repeatedly — the backend replaces stale rows. Returns the updated live status after saving. Raises 409 if the attempt is not IN_PROGRESS or the timer has expired.

Submits the attempt and triggers synchronous scoring. If the timer has already expired, the attempt is marked EXPIRED instead of SUBMITTED. Returns the result_id which you can use to fetch the full result.

get.summary: Get result for a submitted attempt
get.description: Returns the full scoring result for a submitted or expired attempt. Includes per-subject and per-topic breakdowns and per-question answer details for the review screen.
Returns the authenticated user's result history, newest first.

Returns aggregated analytics for the authenticated user,
including total attempts, accuracy, and score trends.

schema.title: Response List Mistakes Api Mistakes Get
Response Practice From Mistakes Api Mistakes Practice Post

post.description:
Uploads a PDF file (max 50 MB) to Supabase Storage, creates metadata records, and queues a background processing job.

The response includes `document_id` and `job_id`. Poll `GET /api/pdfs/{id}/status` to track extraction progress.

Optional metadata (`exam_name`, `exam_year`, `exam_shift`) helps the parser label extracted questions correctly.

get.description:
Poll this endpoint to track PDF processing progress.

`progress_pct`: 0–100 completion percentage.
`current_stage`: human-readable current pipeline stage.
`status`: one of QUEUED, PROCESSING, EXTRACTING, OCR, PARSING, VALIDATING, COMPLETED, FAILED.

Recommended polling interval: 2 seconds while status != COMPLETED|FAILED.

get.summary: List questions extracted from this PDF
get.description: Returns the questions that were extracted and stored from this PDF. Ordered by their original question number in the source paper. All questions start with verification_status=NEEDS_REVIEW.
Returns 200 OK if the service is running. Used by Render health checks.

AnswerDetail.title: AnswerDetail
AnswerDetail.description: Per-question outcome for the review screen.

AnswerSaveRequest.title: AnswerSaveRequest
AnswerSaveRequest.description:
POST /api/attempts/{id}/answers

Saves one or more answers in a single call.
The backend upserts each answer — safe to call repeatedly.

AttemptCreateRequest.title: AttemptCreateRequest
AttemptCreateRequest.description: POST /api/attempts — create a new attempt for a mock test.

AttemptResponse.title: AttemptResponse
AttemptResponse.description: Full attempt response — includes timer info for frontend reconstruction.

AttemptStatusResponse.title: AttemptStatusResponse
AttemptStatusResponse.description:
Returned by GET /api/attempts/{attempt_id}/status.

Contains everything the frontend needs to reconstruct the exam after a
browser refresh, reconnect, or tab switch:
  - Server-computed seconds_remaining (authoritative timer)
  - mock_test_id to reload the question list
  - answers list with the user's persisted selections and mark-for-review flags

IMPORTANT: correct_answer is never included.  This endpoint is safe to
call during an active exam session.

ExamQuestionResponse.title: ExamQuestionResponse
ExamQuestionResponse.description:
Student-safe question payload — used for:
  - GET /api/questions (list items served to students)
  - GET /api/questions/{id}
  - Any endpoint called during an active exam session

MUST NOT contain: correct_answer, explanation, or any answer-key field.
Backend grading services access correct_answer directly from the ORM model,
never through this schema.

GoogleAuthInitResponse.title: GoogleAuthInitResponse
GoogleAuthInitResponse.description: Returned by GET /api/auth/google/login — URL to redirect browser to.

MistakeAddRequest.title: MistakeAddRequest
MistakeAddRequest.description: POST /api/mistakes — manually add a question to the mistake book.

MistakePracticeRequest.title: MistakePracticeRequest
MistakePracticeRequest.description: POST /api/mistakes/practice — generate a mock test from mistake questions.

question_ids.title: Question Ids
question_ids.description: Ordered question UUIDs. Use these to start an attempt.

MockTestDetailResponse.title: MockTestDetailResponse
MockTestDetailResponse.description: Full mock test details including ordered question UUIDs.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: Subject names to include. Empty = all subjects.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Topic UUIDs to include. Empty = all topics.

negative_marking.title: Negative Marking
negative_marking.description: Marks deducted per wrong answer (as a fraction of marks_per_correct).

PaginatedResponse.title: PaginatedResponse
PaginatedResponse.description: Generic paginated response wrapper used by all list endpoints.

PdfUploadResponse.title: PdfUploadResponse
PdfUploadResponse.description: Returned immediately after POST /api/pdfs/upload (before processing starts).

PersistedAnswer.title: PersistedAnswer
PersistedAnswer.description:
A single answer row returned inside AttemptStatusResponse.

Deliberately mirrors SingleAnswerSave so the frontend can seed its local
answer state directly.  This schema MUST NOT include correct_answer,
explanation, or any scoring information — the status endpoint is called
during active exams.

QuestionCreateRequest.title: QuestionCreateRequest
QuestionCreateRequest.description: Used to manually create a question via the API.

QuestionResponse.title: QuestionResponse
QuestionResponse.description:
Full question response including correct_answer and explanation.

ADMIN / CRUD USE ONLY — returned by POST/PATCH on the question bank.
MUST NOT be used for any endpoint a student calls during an active exam.
Use ExamQuestionResponse instead.

ScoreDataPoint.title: ScoreDataPoint
ScoreDataPoint.description: Single point in a score/accuracy trend series.

UserUpdateRequest.title: UserUpdateRequest
UserUpdateRequest.description: Fields the user can update on their profile.
